overall: The AG found the Fall River Licensing Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a generic "Approve all submitted 2016 renewals" topic that did not list each renewal, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the December 16, 2015 notice did not sufficiently identify the liquor licenses the Board would consider for 2016 renewal.
allegations.key_passage: While the notice properly included information about each new license application, the topic on license renewals, "Approve all submitted 2016 renewals," was insufficiently detailed because it failed to include information about each renewal application.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 7 5 2016 - OML 2016-90 - FALL RIVER LICENSING BOARD.pdf
